tbesh_html:
1) to lend, be a creditor
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to lend
1a2) creditor (participle) (subst)
1b) (Hiphil) to lend

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to lend or (by reciprocity) borrow on security or interest
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (rather identical with H5382 (נָשָׁה), in the sense of H5378 (נָשָׁא));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: creditor, exact, extortioner, lend, usurer, lend on (taker on) usury.
